art_instructions: The scene is the sunny front yard of the cozy animal cottage, shown with creamy white walls, terracotta roof tiles, and sage green shutters in the background, with a short cobblestone path leading into the grass. On the right side, a medium-sized leafy tree fills the frame, and directly under its trunk and low roots, in the shade, sits a small brown field mouse, about the size of Panda’s paw. Panda stands in the left foreground on the lawn, occupying the left third of the image, turned toward the tree and pointing with her right paw at the mouse. Her ears tilt back, eyes wide, and mouth a small “o,” with her knees slightly bent and her body leaning away from the tree to show that she is afraid. A colorful ball from their game rests on the grass near Panda’s feet, as if it just rolled to a stop. Bright sunlight casts clear soft-edged shadows so that it is obvious the mouse is under the tree. Add garden details for continuity: a patch of sunflowers on one side and a small lavender bush with a butterfly above it. Optionally include a small speech bubble from Panda saying “ἰδού, ἔστιν μῦς ὑπὸ τὸ δένδρον!” to reinforce the Koine line.
